name: smwgraphics-tom-and-jerry-toys
title: Tom and Jerry - Toys
description:
Background and Foreground of the toys' level in Tom and Jerry (SNES).

Background is kinda huge, uses almost 4 full palette rows, and BG1, BG2 and BG3. Foreground is a bit lighter, uses 2 and a half palette rows and only FG3. Vanilla palette 6 and Status Bar palette are intact as well.

For a better use of the large cheese and 1UP, use custom blocks.
